Work Planning & Packaging

Material Management

Reviews vendor and subcontractor submittals for conformance to engineering requirements and coordinates responses to requests for information.
Quantities
Verifies commodities on quantity tracking systems, validates installation through field inspection and documentation, and tracks craft and subcontract progress for input to schedules and cost reports.

Supports the performance of inspections, development of test plans and procedures, and preparation of inspection reports for the assigned scope, and prepares and closes non-conformance reports.
Coordinates and resolves engineering, procurement, or construction issues with superintendents or other project personnel.
Technical

Coordinates civil/structural engineering solutions with subcontractors, supervision, foremen, and craft professionals, and coordinates with design on constructability issues.
Prepares testing processes and required test equipment, draws field sketches and as built drawings, and inspects installed components for technical acceptance.
Assists in development of commodity installation means and methods, develops an understanding of industry and international codes and standards, and leverages applicable automation software.

Maintain, promote, and cultivate a safe work ethic and work environment within the craft.
Knowledge of civil/structural engineering and construction methods and processes customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.
Computer literate in word processing, spreadsheet, and database applications.
Able to walk the jobsite on uneven surfaces, climb ladders and scaffolding, and use standard issued Personal Protection Equipment (PPE).
Sound communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.

Exposure to civil/structural construction on large industrial or power projects.
Familiarity with applicable civil/structural codes and standards, including ACI.
Experience with construction automation and quantity tracking systems.
